QuestInfo.name: The Town Chief
QuestInfo.0: That's the limit of Mai's knowledge. Now she wants you to meet Lucas, the town chief of Amherst.
QuestInfo.1: That's the limit of Mai's knowledge. Now she wants you to meet Lucas, the town chief of Amherst.
QuestInfo.2: You've officially met Lucas, the town chief of Amherst.

0.0: I guess that's that. You're a true Explorer, now. I'm really, really going to miss you. You were my first true friend.
0.1: It's time for you to expand your horizons. Maybe someday I'll advance past Maple Island, too... In the meantime, find #bLucas#k in #bAmherst#k.

yes.0: Chief Lucas will be waiting for you in Amherst, just over to the right.

no.0: I know, I don't want you to leave either! But I'd feel awful if I held you back. Though... If you really want to stay here with me forever, I won't stop you.

1.0: Well, look what the Maple Tree spit out. You worked with Mai, right? Consider yourself lucky. She's the most powerful person I've ever met. Could use a bit of a confidence boost, though.

yes.0: The text beneath your feet says your name's #h0#,\r\neh? Not as nice a name as 'Lucas,' but we can't all be me.

npc.0: Chief Lucas will be waiting for you in Amherst, just over to the right.
